# Test data notice

- `commonmark-0.31.2.json`: the examples of the CommonMark Spec 0.31.2 by John MacFarlane, <https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/spec.json>, unchanged. Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/>).
- `gfm-0.29-extensions.json`: the extension examples (tables, task list items, strikethrough, autolinks, disallowed raw HTML) of the GitHub Flavored Markdown Spec 0.29-gfm, <https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm/blob/master/test/spec.txt>, extracted to the same JSON shape (an `extension` field added, `→` turned back into a tab). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

Both are kept as test data only (docs/design/components-editor.md 5; PLAN.md, Markdown rendering and the editor).
